title: Partnered with VinUniversity for Driving green practices for Community Empowerment
summary: On October 10, Let’s Do It Vietnam proudly joined forces with the VinUniversity Sustainability Committee to host a community cleanup event in response to World Cleanup Day.

contentBlocks.value: On October 10, Let’s Do It Vietnam proudly joined forces with the VinUniversity Sustainability Committee to host a community cleanup event in response to World Cleanup Day.
After a morning of energetic teamwork, our volunteers successfully cleaned the area, collecting nearly 110kg of waste. Notably, the majority of the waste consisted of single-use plastics.

Beyond the impressive numbers, this event served as a “practical classroom” for VinUni-ers to roll up their sleeves, practice waste sorting at the source, and restore a cleaner, greener space for the community.
A sincere thank you from Let’s Do It Vietnam to all the students, faculty, and staff at VinUni who dedicated their weekend to taking action and making a real impact.
